title: feat(desktop): recording page — Send to…, master tag, copies from this master (NIW2-585)
body:
## What

Reworks the recording page around one idea: **the recording is the master**. The owner's QA of #448 found that "Prepare for…" did not say what it does. This follows section 2, "The recording is the master", of the Claude Design file [Kaipu Prepare.dc.html](https://claude.ai/design/p/71546ef1-baf5-42e9-8fcc-9b9b44f2c7ab?file=Kaipu+Prepare.dc.html).

Linear: [NIW2-585](https://linear.app/niway/issue/NIW2-585/recording-page-send-to-master-indicators-and-copies-from-this-master). Stacked on #448 (`feature/niw2-578-prepare-screen`).

- **Master tag**: a pink-outlined "MASTER · FULL QUALITY" tag with a shield icon sits over the top-left of the player. Originals also carry it on their Library card and row. Copies, screenshots and GIFs never get it (`isMaster` in `lineage.ts`).
- **Send to…** (paper-plane icon) is the primary action. It opens `/prepare/:assetId` with nothing preselected. Edit, Reveal, Remove local download and Delete stay as they were. The card/row icon button is now "Send to…" as well.
- **Meta line** ends with "This is your original. It never changes." If the recording has an edit session, it adds "Your edits live in the editor." This replaces the "ORIGINAL — Your edits are not shown here…" caption under the player.
- **"Where is this going?" strip** (pink tint) has the chips YouTube, GitHub and a dashed More. YouTube opens Prepare with `?to=youtube`, GitHub with `?to=github`, and More with nothing preselected.
- **"Copies from this master"** sits next to the strip and replaces the plain Exports list. Each copy shows:
  - its destination tile, its name and its size;
  - **✓ Ready**, linking to the copy's page.
  
  While this master's background export runs, a row at the top shows **"38% · 2 min"**. It reads `useExportRunner()` and uses the same time-left math as the status card (`exportEtaSeconds`). With no copies, the panel shows one muted line.

## Decisions

- **The heavy-to-send banner folds into the strip on a master.** It duplicated the strip: its only action was "Prepare on GitHub", which the GitHub chip already does. The "119 MB is heavy to send… about 7.6 MB" line now sits inside the strip. A heavy *copy* (no strip) keeps the old banner and its "Prepare a light copy →" action.
- **The master tag replaces the Recording badge** on an original's card and row, instead of sitting beside it. The card's corner is too narrow for both, and the tag already says it is a recording. Copies keep the Recording or GIF badge.
- **How each copy is named.** A copy made for a destination (fingerprint `whole`) is named after its destination (`destinationOfPreset`; YouTube adds 1440p or 4K). An editor export or a GIF uses its own title, so an editor's Balanced export is not called "Slack · Discord · Email".
  - So that the running row follows the same rule, `ExportJobInfo` gets an optional `wholeRecording` flag, set in `startVideoExport`. It is the only change outside the recording page and the cards.
- **A copy that has copies of its own** (Send to… also works from a copy's page) shows the same panel titled "Copies from this file". The "Where is this going?" strip appears only on masters.
- **i18n**: new keys sit in one block at the end of the `library` namespace, in English and neutral Spanish. The removed keys are `library.exports`, `library.originalLabel` and `library.originalPlayerNote`, which nothing uses anymore. The `prepare.prepareFor*` / `prepare.quick*` keys are left in place so this PR doesn't edit the `prepare` block that NIW2-583 is changing. They can go once that PR lands.
- Not touched: the post-recording "Your video is ready" panel (NIW2-584), the Prepare page (NIW2-583), the status cards, the sidebar and the Library header (NIW2-586).

## Verification

- `bun run verify` from the repo root passes (kaipu-record: 311 files, 3016 tests).
- New tests:
  - `master-copies-panel.test.tsx`: empty state, destination naming plus Ready link, editor export and GIF naming, running row with percent and time left, percent only before an estimate exists, and the `runningCopyOf` selection.
  - Master-tag tests on the card and the row.
- Updated tests: `library-detail-page.test.tsx` (Send to…, the strip's three chips, master tag and note, the copies panel, the heavy hint folded into the strip, a heavy copy keeping its banner) and the card test.
- **Not run in Electron.** Layout and runtime behaviour need the owner's QA.

## How to test it yourself

1. Run `bun run dev` and open any recording in the Library.
   - Expect the pink **MASTER · FULL QUALITY** tag on the player's top-left corner, with the video still playable underneath.
   - Expect the meta line to end with "This is your original. It never changes."
2. Click **Send to…**. Prepare should open with no destination selected. Go back.
3. Under the title, the **Where is this going?** strip:
   - **YouTube** should open Prepare on YouTube;
   - **GitHub** should open it on GitHub;
   - **More** should open it with nothing selected.
4. With no copies yet, **Copies from this master** should show one muted line.
5. Start a YouTube copy from Prepare and come back to the recording. The copies panel should show "YouTube 1440p" with "N% · X min", counting up. When it finishes it should become "YouTube 1440p · 5xx MB ✓ Ready". Clicking it should open the copy's page, which has no master tag.
6. Open a recording over 25 MB. The "heavy to send" line should sit inside the strip, with no separate teal banner. Then open a heavy copy (for example the YouTube copy): it should still show the banner with "Prepare a light copy →".
7. Open a recording that has edits. The meta line should add "Your edits live in the editor."
8. In the Library, grid and list views:
   - originals should show **MASTER · FULL QUALITY** instead of "Recording";
   - copies, screenshots and GIFs should keep their usual badge;
   - the paper-plane button should open Prepare.
9. Switch the app to Spanish and repeat one screen. You should see "Enviar a…", "¿A dónde va?" and "Copias de este máster".
